facts.fact: The EPF interest rate for FY 2025-26 is 8.25% per annum, recommended by the EPFO Central Board of Trustees at its 239th meeting
facts.quote: After due deliberations, CBT recommended 8.25 % annual rate of interest to be credited on EPF accumulations in members’ accounts for the financial year 2025-26.

facts.fact: The 8.25% rate for FY 2025-26 has since been officially notified
facts.quote: EPFO has officially notified an 8.25 percent interest rate on EPF deposits for financial year 2025-26.

facts.fact: Yes, it is the same as last year: the rate for FY 2024-25 was also 8.25%
facts.quote: The rate of interest on EPF deposits for FY 2024–25 has been declared at 8.25%.

facts.fact: The recommendation was made at the 239th CBT meeting, announced by PIB on 2 March 2026
facts.quote: Posted On: 02 MAR 2026 3:37PM by PIB Delhi Union Minister for Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports, Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya chaired the 239th meeting of Central Board of Trustees (CBT)

summary: 8.25% for FY 2025-26 (CBT 239th meeting, since notified) is the same as FY 2024-25; all facts confirmed.
